visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts on the deck of a fishing boat during the day. A man with a goatee, wearing a green t-shirt, black shorts, a black baseball cap, and white work gloves, is speaking directly to the camera while gesturing with his hands. Behind him, various boat components like orange pillars, blue metal frames, and hanging equipment are visible. The lighting is bright and natural, indicating an outdoor setting. (2) A woman in a navy blue oversized t-shirt and black shorts with white sneakers enters the frame from the right. She is also wearing white work gloves. They are engaged in a conversation, smiling and laughing. Animated overlays of a dragon boat and lightbulbs appear as they talk. (3) The man picks up a long metal tool and mimics the motion of rowing a boat. Animated fire effects burst from the end of the tool in sync with his movements. The woman watches him and reacts with a surprised expression. The camera stays in a medium shot, capturing their upper bodies and interactions. (4) The camera cuts to a slightly different angle showing the side of the boat's interior. Another man in a blue shirt is seen bending over and working on some machinery or a hole in the boat. The main male character continues to talk excitedly, pointing towards the camera as more variety-style text and icons (like a roasted chicken) appear on the screen.

(2) A female voice laughs and responds in a higher, excited pitch. Short, sharp 'ding' and 'whoosh' SFX punctuate the man's comedic suggestions about the boat. (3) As the man mimics rowing, loud, crackling fire sound effects and percussive 'impact' sounds are layered over the voices to emphasize his physical movements. (4) The BGM shifts slightly in rhythm as more people's laughter is heard in the background. The dialogue remains very fast-paced and high-arousal, typical of an entertainment variety show.

The intent is to entertain through humor by proposing an absurd crossover between traditional 'Sulfur Fire Fishing' (Bong-ho-ah) and Dragon Boat racing, specifically involving cooking a chicken with the boat's fire.
